headlines.title: Tracking U.S., state and county gas prices, in maps and charts
headlines.description: Are gas prices declining? NBC News is tracking national, state and county prices at the pump.

headlines.title: Tech stocks erase $1 trillion of wealth as oil surges to $110 for the first time since May
headlines.description: Tech stocks shed more than $1 trillion in value Friday, as the price of oil soared to its highest levels in five months.

headlines.title: Neighboring Gas Stations Compete to Offer Lowest Prices
headlines.description: NBC’s Hallie Jackson runs through the Highs and Lows of the week on Sunday TODAY including the neighboring gas stations that went head-to-head to offer low prices in Georgia, the dad who took his daughters to see Olivia Rodrigo and rocked out even more than they did and more.

headlines.title: Get an Exclusive First Look at Google's New 'When to Buy' Guide
headlines.description: Google dropped its brand new "When to Buy Guide" Thursday morning with advice on how and where to shop all the best deals between now and the new year. NBC's Vicky Nguyen shares an exclusive first look on TODAY to break it all down and help you create the perfect holiday shopping strategy.

headlines.title: Inflation Jumps Amid Rising Fuel Prices: How it Impacts Americans
headlines.description: Inflation jumped to 3.7%, driven by gas and diesel prices triggered by the U.S. war with Iran. NBC’s Christine Romans joins TODAY to break down which categories will see price increases and what’s behind the spike in costs.

headlines.title: How grocery prices have changed since Trump took office
headlines.description: Learn where grocery prices stand during the Trump administration. See how inflation is affecting the cost of eggs, bread, chicken, ground beef and more.

headlines.title: To counteract a spooky economy, America prepares to spend on Halloween candy
headlines.description: This Halloween, rising prices for groceries and gas are pushing many consumers to cut back. But they’re not giving up Halloween candy.

headlines.title: Elon Musk shows off ‘flying’ Tesla Roadster after years of delays
headlines.description: Elon Musk showed off the new Tesla Roadster prototype Thursday that can briefly launch itself into the air using rocket-inspired thrusters.

headlines.title: Alaska Senate candidates clash over the Iran war, high prices and their times in office
headlines.description: The two major candidates vying for an Alaska Senate seat squared off Thursday night over issues ranging from the war with Iran to controversies during the Democratic nominee’s time in Congress in a debate that at times flared into personal attacks.

headlines.title: Kevin Warsh says Fed is focused on taming rising prices, but gives no hint about next rate hike
headlines.description: Two inflation reports this week set the stage for a rate hike potentially sooner than previously expected.

headlines.title: Cracks are beginning to show in the stock market as doubts about AI investments grow
headlines.description: Consumers already face a host of stressors. If AI spending and tech stocks show signs of sustained decline, U.S. economic growth could be at risk.

headlines.title: Inflation hit businesses even harder than consumers last month
headlines.description: Various efforts by the Trump administration to bring down prices have failed to make a meaningful dent in rising costs.
